{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Wrap-style midi dress, sleeveless with a V neckline, fitted waist and flowing A-line skirt falling to mid-calf, in deep sage green (#5E7F73), silk crepe with a soft satin sheen. The back is covered, and the bare arms are the only open zone.

Block-heeled sandals with an ankle strap, mid-height heel, in warm nude (#D8B79B), smooth leather

Envelope clutch, small, in soft gold (#C9A96A), silk satin

Drop earrings, medium length, in polished gold (#C9A96A), metal with a small pearl

Thin bangle bracelet in polished gold (#C9A96A), metal

This outfit meets the formal level for a close family member with a dress of noble fabric and heeled shoes, and the midi length keeps it elegant without feeling like a gown. The deep sage picks up the grey-green of her eyes and glows against her warm skin and golden hair, while staying well clear of white and ivory so the bride stays the focus. Silk crepe is light and breathable for an August afternoon outdoors, and the flowing skirt moves easily from the ceremony to the restaurant. Block heels stay steady on grass, and the gold details add a festive finish for the evening without any need for an outer layer."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2589,"output_tokens":1051},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
